_about.chapter: Audio: which music plays where, how each place echoes, the sound effects' lengths and voice caps, each car brand's motor, and the floors footsteps hear.
_about.how_to_edit: Plain JSON, inlined by tools/build.mjs as GAME_DB.audio and checked by tools/test-game-db.cjs. Map ids are the ids in world/maps.js. A "note" is for people only.

tables.buffers: Settings > Audio Buffer: each choice and the AudioContext latencyHint it opens with (read as AUDIO_BUFFERS, directory/game-sound.js).
tables.sfx_length: How long each sfx() recipe rings, in seconds (SFX_DUR).
tables.sfx_voices: How many of each sound may ring at once; a sound not listed gets 6 (SFX_CAP).
tables.engine_hum: Each car brand's electric motor (ENGINE_HUM): root pitch in Hz; body, shimmer and whine are the voices' weights; level is its volume. Brands are VEHICLE_BRANDS.
tables.reverb: The rooms as reverb (REVERB), each [decay s, predelay ms, damping Hz, wet], and for valley also [echo delay s, echo feedback, echo level]: street (a short slap off the buildings), open (a hillside), room (a furnished room), bathroom (tile and marble), hall (a lobby, a club floor), stone (a church, a palace), cabin (the van), void (the ethereal plane), valley (open ground under cliffs).
tables.map_reverb: Each map's room, by map id (MAP_REVERB). Indoor maps not listed are room, outdoor ones street.
tables.room_reverb: Rooms inside a map whose echo differs, by room kind (ROOM_REVERB).
tables.map_music: A soundtrack per map (MAP_MUSIC): track is a file in assets/audio without its extension; room is where its speakers are (fullest there); volume its level; bpm and beat0 give a tempo the lights can follow. A list holds area tracks (the nearest wins): area names a place (hub_graveyard) or building names a building footprint; fade is px; lowpass Hz muffles it.
tables.club_bpm: Moon City's tempo when no track is playing (CLUB_BPM).
tables.floors: Floors per painted map for footsteps (FLOOR_MATERIALS, engine/footsteps.js): def is the floor everywhere else; rects are [x, y, w, h, material], first match wins. Materials: marble, wood, carpet, stone, concrete, asphalt, grass, metal, water.

moon_city_nightclub.note: Swig, the club's cut: a 24-bar loop at 140 BPM, the kick on the first sample; the club's lights dance to it.

keepers_hill.note: The Visitor: the Keeper's fireside. The same track on the hill and in the parlor, so it plays on across the cut.

van_interior.note: The van on the way to the job (the intro), over the rain on the roof and the road.

sdc.note: Grave Stories: the southern graveyard in Southern Dimensions City (its walls, engine/map-loading.js).
Moon City's bass through its walls: heard as you come up to the club, low-passed to the thump; its lights keep time.
